title: Counting birds at the pond
passage: For the pond count, meet at the wooden rail, not the fishing platform. Stay on the path to protect the new grass. If a bird moves from the water to the bank, mark its first entry with an arrow rather than counting it twice. At the shelter, use sheets from the same section to cross-check, not to add totals. If they differ, compare the notes before choosing a count.
passageZh: 池塘鳥類調查請到木欄杆旁集合，不要到釣魚平台。請留在步道上，保護新種的草。若某隻鳥從水面移到岸邊，請在第一次記錄旁加箭頭，不要重複計數。到了休息亭，請用同一區的記錄表互相核對，不要把數字相加。如果數字不同，先比對註記，再決定採用哪個數量。
